description: Agent preflight round 3: check your own agent spending policy before the agent runs under it. Input text, fields (per_call_cap, daily_cap, allowed_assets, allowed_networks, recipient_allowlist, approval_thresholds, kill_switch, categories with optional caps, currency) or both. The signed report marks each control present, missing or ambiguous, with quotes, and names the dangerous shapes plainly: a category with no cap, a daily cap with no per-call cap, a per-call cap with nothing capping the total, spending stated as unlimited, any recipient, asset or network allowed, and no way to stop the agent. POST /api/spending-policy-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no registry or chain lookup, no counterparty contact, and no payment signed, submitted or moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-preflight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/preflight/.

inputSchema.description: Send the text, the fields or both.

fields.description: The policy by control. A field given here takes precedence over the text for that control.

allowed_assets.description: The assets the agent may pay in, for example ["USDC"].

allowed_networks.description: The networks the agent may pay on, for example ["Base"] or ["eip155:8453"].

approval_thresholds.description: The amounts above which a payment needs approval, and from whom.

cap.description: Optional cap for this category, as an amount or as written, for example "200 USD per month".

category.description: What the agent may spend on, for example "API calls" or "travel".

categories.description: Spending categories as text or up to 50 entries, each a category with an optional cap.

currency.description: Optional currency or asset for amounts sent as numbers, for example "USDC" or "USD".

daily_cap.description: The most the agent may spend in one day, as an amount or as written.

kill_switch.description: How the agent is stopped or its spending revoked, and by whom.

per_call_cap.description: The largest single payment the agent may make, as an amount or as written, for example "0.50 USDC per call".

recipient_allowlist.description: The rule for who the agent may pay: an allowlist, addresses or how a recipient gets approved.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

text.description: The spending policy as written, up to 64 KB.

name: wever_spending-policy-check
title: Spending policy check
